# Monthly product-profit workspace — surgical delivery plan

**Status:** proposed planning backlog, 2026-09-29. The user requested a plan and GitHub issues now, then definition of specific details, implementation and UI refinement. Creating these issues does not approve unresolved definitions, expand source permissions or start application work.

**Goal:** help the owner answer, for a selected month: which products sold and in what quantities, how each product contributed to profit, and what the overall profit was. Present this as one scrolling page assembled from existing modules.

**Working definition to confirm in P01 (#38):** gross product profit before shop operating expenses. With the approved historical last-purchase method this remains an estimate (`Tahmini brüt kâr`). It is not exact inventory profit, net profit or cash in the bank. No expense-completeness requirement should block this gross-profit experience. Existing expense features, records and operating reports remain preserved and reachable separately.

## Why this is a focused change

- Reviewed local baseline: `b2b2e0a`. Current remote main: [`6d717bef`](https://github.com/AlesSystems/esmer-market-analytics/commit/6d717bef53f3a7fcf23bb9845e809ae9c79603a3), including merged #37, which makes SQL import the primary empty-state action. Implementation must start from current main and preserve other work; no change to the separate SQL-default worktree is part of this plan.
- Real SQL currently produces recorded-row previews. Making SQL the default did not validate financial meaning or connect raw rows to profit calculations.
- Existing `calculateSales`, `estimateGrossResult`, `GrossResult`, product sales breakdowns, `MonthlyReport`/display, accepted reports, Excel export and recovery already cover much of the required structure for supported synthetic data. Reuse and extend these paths.
- #26 is now closed; its unresolved financial-semantic/capacity obligations are carried explicitly in this plan. Closed tracker status is not acceptance evidence. Do not reopen it or assume all its historical checklist items passed.
- This expands the previous two-line scope of #36, “Fix UI in all pages / Debug integration,” into a concrete profit-focused workstream. The broader delivery tracker remains #3.

## Proposed owner page

| Order | Section | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Month, source cutoff and compact readiness | Establish the period and whether the numbers are complete, estimated or unavailable |
| 2 | Overall estimated gross profit and coverage | Answer the main question, showing covered profit rather than an unqualified whole-store number when evidence is incomplete |
| 3 | Daily profit trend | Explain when the month’s supported contribution occurred |
| 4 | Product contribution table | Product identity/display, sold/returned/net quantity with unit, net sales, estimated historical cost, profit and coverage; bounded search/sort/paging |
| 5 | Selected product and line evidence | Explain its profit using actual recognized sales/returns and historical cost evidence |
| Secondary | Source details, imports, saved reports/export, expenses and recovery | Keep existing capabilities accessible without dominating the profit page |

This is a composition proposal for P01 (#38) review, not final labels or pixel design. Build the working flow before the focused visual pass. Do not paste complete existing pages into one enormous DOM or monolithic component.

## Architecture and extension rules

Keep the current Electron/TypeScript/React/local Node/SQLite application and named validated IPC. SQL extraction feeds a reviewed normalization/package contract; atomic activation feeds local reports; service-side decimal calculations feed typed report data; React renders focused sections. Preparation and any authorized isolated refresh use the same mapping.

- Reuse `src/analytics/sales.ts` and `costs.ts` for recognized financial components. Product, day and overall aggregates use the same covered population and one calculation policy.
- Extend `src/reports/contracts.ts`, `query.ts`, `display.ts`, `versions.ts` and `export.ts` only as needed. Report consumers share dataset, month, calculation version, coverage and provenance; renderer sections do not recalculate money.
- Compose `AppShell`, the monthly overview, existing table/chart patterns, cost evidence and report controls. Extract only sections that need reuse. Page navigation/state has one owner; each section handles its presentation.
- New owner requests should add or extend the relevant calculation/report/section, with tests at its existing interface. Avoid a plugin framework, generic dashboard builder, event bus, new state library, microservices or speculative abstraction.
- Version persisted report/package changes when needed. Old accepted reports stay reproducible; new formulas or source corrections create a candidate revision. Existing report/expense/recovery contract tests protect sibling features.
- No full rewrite, new framework or dependency is assumed. Measure before introducing streaming, new caches or storage formats.

## Boundaries to resolve rather than hide

1. **Profit definition:** confirm gross versus operating profit and exact Turkish terminology in P01 (#38). Historical last-purchase cost remains estimated even after review.
2. **Partial evidence:** product contributions must sum to the same covered monthly result. Missing cost is not zero; unsupported sales/costs have counts and monetary exposure. A partial covered sum must not be advertised as the complete market profit.
3. **Product/cost source fields:** the [recorded-row program](https://github.com/AlesSystems/AlesSystems-Workstreams/blob/main/Esmer%20Market%20Analytics/plans/2026-09-26-live-and-backup-display.md) and current preview allowlist exclude product-name/cost expansion. A separately reviewed minimal financial projection and an explicit scope decision are prerequisites. This plan does not silently widen the raw preview or authorize customer, employee or supplier fields.
4. **Foundation delta:** product profit becomes the primary owner flow; expense/operating features are secondary, not removed. P01 (#38) records the agreed change against the foundation rather than silently changing financial requirements.
5. **Access and deployment:** this planning task accesses no database. Renewed source inspection needs the applicable authorization and an isolated restored backup. Production access, owner contact/installation and L01 rollout remain separate.

## Delivery issues and dependencies

- [ ] #38 — **P01 (#38)**: Define the monthly product-profit contract and source scope. Completion dependencies: None; next definition discussion.
- [ ] #39 — **P02 (#39)**: Validate SQL sales and historical cost evidence for product profit. Completion dependencies: #38.
- [ ] #40 — **P03 (#40)**: Feed validated SQL profit data through the existing import pipeline. Completion dependencies: #38, #39.
- [ ] #41 — **P04 (#41)**: Add reconcilable product and overall gross-profit reports. Completion dependencies: #38, #40.
- [ ] #42 — **P05 (#42)**: Compose one scrolling profit workspace from existing UI components. Completion dependencies: #38, #41.
- [ ] #43 — **P06 (#43)**: Verify the profit workflow in the existing harness and packaged Windows app. Completion dependencies: #39, #40, #41, #42.

The release dependency order is P01 (#38) → P02 (#39) → P03 (#40) → P04 (#41) → P05 (#42) → P06 (#43). After P01 (#38), synthetic P04 (#41) calculations and P05 (#42) sketches may be prepared while source evidence is pending, but neither establishes real-data readiness or bypasses its issue’s exit dependencies. P06 (#43) is integrated acceptance; tests begin within each earlier issue.

## Harness and completion contract

Reuse the existing Vitest, packaged Playwright and synthetic SQL tools. Every behavior issue starts with an independent expected result and a failing contract, then the minimum implementation and relevant regression checks. Do not calculate expected profit using the same implementation under test.

For a pinned period/population, verify source evidence → normalized records → product/day/overall totals → screen/detail → saved report → Excel. Exercise returns, missing costs, losses, mixed units, partial months, corrections/deletes, source reset, stale contexts, interrupted imports and offline recovery. Synthetic tests demonstrate software behavior; authorized real evidence establishes source meaning. Passing agents or screenshots alone establish neither.

Use the relevant `test:unit`, `test:integration`, `test:desktop`, `typecheck`, `lint` and `build` scripts. Packaged Windows checks and `package:win` are required for Windows acceptance. Measure representative/full approved volume against the below-two-second dashboard/drill-down target; document memory/disk/import bounds. Preserve app-owned data and accepted reports through every replacement/recovery scenario. Public media uses synthetic data only.

Each issue reports branch/commit/build, fixture or opaque source batch, environment, expected/actual result, evidence and unresolved gates. Review the exact candidate commit before handoff. No merge, deployment or owner contact is included in the present planning request.

## Requirements and baseline references

- [Foundation specification](https://github.com/AlesSystems/esmer-market-analytics/blob/6d717bef53f3a7fcf23bb9845e809ae9c79603a3/docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-04-esmer-market-rebuild-design.md): D02/D04/D07/D13/D15/D16/D18/D19.
- [Source audit](https://github.com/AlesSystems/esmer-market-analytics/blob/6d717bef53f3a7fcf23bb9845e809ae9c79603a3/docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-04-esmer-market-rebuild-audit.md) and [source contract](https://github.com/AlesSystems/esmer-market-analytics/blob/6d717bef53f3a7fcf23bb9845e809ae9c79603a3/docs/contracts/source.md).
- [Acceptance criteria](https://github.com/AlesSystems/esmer-market-analytics/blob/6d717bef53f3a7fcf23bb9845e809ae9c79603a3/docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-04-esmer-market-rebuild-acceptance.md): A01–A07, with L01 separate.
- [Existing implementation plan](https://github.com/AlesSystems/esmer-market-analytics/blob/6d717bef53f3a7fcf23bb9845e809ae9c79603a3/docs/superpowers/plans/esmer-market-implementation-plan.md): Tasks 2.1/2.2, 3.1/3.2, 5.1/5.2, 6.1, 8.1/8.2 and 10.1/10.2.

The plan and its task definitions live in these GitHub issues to avoid a second drifting roadmap. Detailed code signatures and implementation steps are settled in P01 (#38) and source-backed specifics in P02 (#39) before their dependent implementation issues become executable.
title: [Plan] Track monthly product profit in one reusable workspace
